Name: Enchanted Garden (PIF)
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]
[size=4]
Is enchanted garden, an outdoor, where if you want it will always be spring (configurable in Generic Mod Config Menu), It has a boat that takes you to the beach and a brand new feature, the working minecart in PIF rooms!
You can go into the pool to recharge your energy, construct buildings and plant any crops because they will grow here like a greenhouse and they could become giant, occasionally meet wild animals, the fishing here is great, but you will be surprised to catch some unusual fish like catfish, sturgeon, goby and Woodskip.
It is really a relaxing little paradise, I had fun creating it, I hope it can give fun to everyone!
[/size][size=4]Version 1.0.8 - Now, through GMCM, you can choose whether to have a wooden or stone bridge. (See latest images)[/size]
[size=4]
I have created glass doors that go well with my greenhouses or exteriors, which can be purchased at Robin's store, you can find them here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28160]Dynamic Glass Doors for PIF Windows and Plants[/url]

[/size]Installation:
Extract and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.

Remember to update PIF mod or it may not work properly.

[color=#00ffff][size=3]How do you access the PIF rooms?[/size][/color]
[color=#00ffff][size=3]First install the mod and dependencies, then go either to Robin's store or to the wizard under the tunnel west of the bus stop, buy a door, go home and hang it on the wall, then choose the room and enter.[/size][/color]

Enjoy! <3
[size=3]
It is fitting to thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/109248658]DeLiXxN[/url] who as soon as I asked her about the possibility of putting a minecart in the PIF rooms she worked hard to make it possible and for her kindness. <3[/size][size=4]

[/size]Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]

If you appreciate my work could you buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?
